# Happy Pack Adventures LLC
> Premier Wedding Day Dog Chaperone & Concierge Pet Care

Happy Pack Adventures provides professional wedding-day dog care, aisle escorting, photo assistance, and climate-controlled venue transportation for couples across Birmingham, Hoover, Pelham, and Central Alabama.

- Founder & Master Handler: Melissa Floyd
- Primary Service: Wedding Day Dog Chaperone & Attendant Services
- Coverage Scopes: Photo Companion (Portraits), Ceremony Companion (Aisle + Ceremony + Photos), Extended Wedding Care (All-Day + Evening Sitting)
- Contact: melissa@happypackadventures.com | (205) 555-PAWS
- Service Areas: Birmingham, AL; Hoover, AL; Pelham, AL; Mountain Brook, AL; Vestavia Hills, AL; Central Alabama
- Booking Policy: Dates are officially confirmed once the care agreement is signed and the date-lock booking deposit is received.
